title: 第7章 去要塞卖物资第8章 自愿为奴的奴隶们
slug: 领主反派破灭后开始当战犯
content_zh:
回去之后的艾克雷就将自己所知道一切都告诉给林恩听，林恩没什么震惊的神色，反而还认为自己的直觉就是没错，有人要害他。
只不过是兽人。
艾克雷:“林恩大人，您也太淡定了点吧？”
莉莉姆：“主人，我们觉得我们还是得慎重考虑。”
林恩此时拿着魔杖，使用魔法控制泥土塑型成砖头的样子然后摆放到地上让奴隶搬走拿去烧，被这两个人突然袭脸，真是搞的头大，效率都变差了。
“我在做措施了啊，慌什么。”
“艾克雷，快去带领骑士去找一些史莱姆回来，我要做史莱姆农场。”
“莉莉姆，你计算一下钱财留下足够购买半年粮食的钱，留做备用，对了，去的时候马车也别空着，把牛肉带上，我要亲自去要塞那边招募点人，还有购买奴隶以及谷物。”
林恩就算没有外部的威胁，也早就计划好了一切，从决定不当二游男主开始。
之前的慌张只是梦想当二游幸福男主的残留还在而已，一想到自己都被流放了还不被人放过就一阵伤心。
是的，不是害怕，林恩从头到尾就没怕过，即使知道自己是反派黄毛也没怕过。
他从来只是伤心而已。
林恩现在就在完成他的国策【阿宁斯贝城】修建起城墙。
虽然没有系统，但他的首要目标就没变过，先修城墙，同时想想有什么赚钱的办法。
大量砍伐树木烧制木炭，大量烧制砖头进行基建，修建城墙。
林恩现在不断的制作着原材料，接下来就是要寻找人才了。
铁匠，木匠，工程师都得采矿学的人，这些有一技之长的人不可能成为奴隶，就算成为了也会成为自由人。
毕竟要是人家不高兴，给你偷工减料你就麻烦了。
莉莉姆和艾克雷两人已经无语了，林恩就像患有间接性脑疾一样。
一下像个英明的君主一样，一下像个地主家的猥琐傻儿子一样。

艾克雷跟在林恩身边那么久也是清楚的，一到行政的时候就是英明君主附体，总是能不经意间说出一些十分有用的话。
解决过好多起事件。
问题在于一旦到了人与人的层面上去，完全就是个孩子。
现在的样子是君主附体没错了。
这个状态下听着干就完事了。
......
斯霍尔堡，这里是一处伯爵领，是奥莱西安公国防御北境的前线，由于位隘口，商业矿业也是极其发达的。
同时，一部分亚人也会来这里采购过冬需要的物资，商人们也愿意高价出售盐，铁锅，谷物之类的玩意去换取皮毛制品，以及各种珍贵的草药。
林恩带来的东西一下子就卖完了。
随后就是就带着莉莉姆四处走，寻找有什么值得买的东西。
“这里的亚人好多啊！”莉莉姆久违的看见同类耳朵都立起来了，十分兴奋。
content_en:
After returning, Aikeli told Linn everything he knew. Linn didn't look shocked. Instead, he believed that his intuition was right and that someone was trying to harm him.
Just orcs.
Aikere: "Master Linn, are you too calm?"
Lilim: "Master, we think we still have to think carefully."
Lin En was holding the wand at this time, using magic to control the clay to shape into bricks, and then placed them on the ground for the slaves to move and burn. He was suddenly attacked in the face by these two men, which really messed him up and made his efficiency worse.
"I'm taking measures, why are you panicking?"
"Aikere, go and lead the knights to find some slimes and come back. I want to make a slime farm."
"Lilim, please calculate your money and leave enough money to buy food for half a year. Keep it as a backup. By the way, don't leave the carriage empty when you go. Bring the beef with you. I will personally go to the fortress to recruit some people and buy slaves and grain."
Even if there was no external threat, Lin En had already planned everything, starting from the moment he decided not to be the male protagonist of the second game.
The panic before was just the remnant of the dream of being a happy male protagonist in the second game. The thought of being exiled and not being spared made me sad.
Yes, it's not that he was afraid. Lin En was never afraid from the beginning to the end, even when he knew he was the villain Huang Mao.
He was never just sad.
Lin En is now completing his national policy [Aninsibe City] and building a city wall.
Although there is no system, his primary goal has not changed, which is to build the city wall first and think about ways to make money at the same time.
A large number of trees were cut down to burn charcoal, and a large number of bricks were burned for infrastructure construction and city walls.
Lin En is now constantly producing raw materials, and the next step is to find talents.
Blacksmiths, carpenters, and engineers all have to be people with mining skills. These skilled people cannot become slaves, and even if they become, they will become free people.
After all, if someone is unhappy and cuts corners for you, you'll be in trouble.
Lilim and Aikere were speechless, and Linn seemed to be suffering from an indirect brain disease.
One moment he looks like a wise monarch, the next moment he looks like a wretched and foolish son of a landlord.
Aikeli has been with Lin En for so long and he knows that when it comes to administration, he is possessed by a wise monarch and can always say some very useful words inadvertently.
Many incidents have been resolved.
The problem is that once you get to the level of human beings, you are completely like a child.
The way he looks now is that he is possessed by the monarch.
In this state, just listen and do it.
...
Schollburg is a county and the front line of the Olesian Principality's defense against the northern border. Due to its location at the pass, commercial mining is also extremely developed.
At the same time, some demi-humans will also come here to purchase supplies needed for the winter, and merchants are also willing to sell salt, iron pots, grains and other things at high prices in exchange for fur products and various precious herbs.
Everything Lynn brought was sold out instantly.
Then he took Lilim around to look for anything worth buying.
"There are so many demi-humans here!" Lilim's ears stood up after seeing similar people for a long time, and she was very excited.
